claims.statement: Poland's Ministry of Finance states that mandatory KSeF issuing began in phases in February and April 2026, while receiving through KSeF became mandatory from February 2026.
Official guidance distinguishes online, offline24, scheduled-unavailability, emergency, and total-failure procedures with different later-submission rules; special modes use KSeF certificates.

contrary_evidence: ERP and accounting vendors already implement core KSeF transport and may add reconciliation.
The Ministry offers free taxpayer applications, constraining a simple connector.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: a labelled corpus of KSeF failure sequences and resolution playbooks across many ERP implementations
fingerprint.customer: Polish accounting firms managing many SME taxpayers across heterogeneous invoicing tools
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: accounting-software resellers, payroll/accounting associations, and white-label ERP connectors
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: read-mostly reconciliation API, deadline engine, exception queue, and exportable evidence trail
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the accounting office pays per office and invoice monitored
fingerprint.problem_trigger: an invoice's local state diverges from KSeF or an offline/awaryjny deadline starts

founder_fit: A Poland-specific, measurable automation wedge suited to data engineering and part-time work; one accounting-office integration reaches many end customers.
risks: Tax-document and credential security is critical.
Incorrect deadline advice can cause liability.
The service should monitor and evidence, not act as tax counsel.

structure.control_point: the reconciled mapping between the taxpayer ledger, KSeF number, legal issue date, and offline resubmission deadline
structure.critical_dependency: stable KSeF API access plus trustworthy invoice identifiers and event sequences from client systems

thesis: A wholesale reliability rail can sit between small accounting firms' client ERPs and KSeF, continuously detecting rejected, duplicated, missing, permission-blocked, and offline-mode invoices and preserving a human-readable resolution trail. It sells once to an accounting office but monitors many taxpayers and invoices, with every transmission exception creating measurable value.
title: KSeF Exception and Offline Reconciliation Rail for Accounting Firms
uncertainties: API rate and permission constraints for multi-client offices.
